facts.fact: InnovRIM, operator of SahelFabLab, is running the Agri-Innovation Start-Up Cup 2026 with FAO and ILO, planning 20 startups across Bassiknou and Dar Naim with a three-day bootcamp and six weeks of incubation and mentoring.
